department: Department of Chemical and Sustainability Engineering

deadline.quote: The PhD application closes on January 5, 2027.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are encouraged but not required.
gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores is encouraged but not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 95 is preferred for admittance.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 620 (paper-based test), 260 (computer-based test), or 95 (Internet test) is preferred for admittance.

ielts_min.quote: A minimum IELTS band score of 7.0 is preferred for admittance.

english_waiver.value: The department waives the test only for graduates of a US undergraduate program with two years of study in the US; Indian degrees do not qualify.
english_waiver.quote: The English proficiency exam requirement is waived for applicants who are graduates of a U.S. undergraduate program with a minimum of two years of study in the U.S.

supervisor.value: Faculty do not admit applicants to their groups directly; admission is through the department.
supervisor.quote: Individual chemical engineering faculty members do not admit applicants directly to their research groups.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students receive fellowships or research assistantships with a stipend, medical benefits and full tuition.
funding.quote: Our full-time PhD students receive competitive graduate fellowships or research assistantships comprising an annual stipend of at least $30,000 (from fall 2022), medical benefits, and full coverage of graduate tuition.

entry_route.value: Open to anyone with a bachelor's degree; a chemical engineering degree is not required.
entry_route.quote: Our graduate program is open to all applicants who have completed a bachelor

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to this field and the page does not mention one.
